note: Security Deep Scan §40 (S-A14): the body routes that do NOT refuse unknown fields, each a reviewed exception with its reason. Every other body route is strict — see strict-bodies.vitest.spec.ts.

exceptions.PATCH /tenant/ai/receptionist/settings: Open by design: ReceptionistSettingsService.validatePatch refuses an unknown setting with its own named error, so unknown keys are KEPT for it to see; bounded (S.bounded: x-maxDepth 2, x-maxNodes 200).
exceptions.POST /api/ai-receptionist/v1/appointment: Retell custom function (docs/ai-receptionist/retell-functions.json): the arguments are generated by the voice agent's LLM — an extra argument must not fail a live phone call. Every documented parameter is declared (callId added Oct 27 2026) and typed; anything else is stripped.

Retell custom function: LLM-generated arguments — an extra argument must not fail a live call. Every documented parameter (appointmentId, callId, callerConfirmed, name, phone, reason, requestId) is declared and typed; anything else is stripped.

Retell custom function: LLM-generated arguments — an extra argument must not fail a live call. Every documented parameter (appointmentId, callId, callerConfirmed, date, name, phone, reason, requestId, startTime) is declared and typed; anything else is stripped.
exceptions.POST /api/ai-receptionist/v1/customers/l: Retell custom function: LLM-generated arguments — an extra argument must not fail a live call. Every documented parameter (callId, consent, firstName, lastName, phone, requestId) is declared and typed; anything else is stripped.
exceptions.POST /api/ai-receptionist/v1/handoff: Retell custom function: LLM-generated arguments — an extra argument must not fail the hand-off to a human. Every documented parameter (callId, reason, requestId, summary) is declared and typed; anything else is stripped.
exceptions.POST /api/ai-receptionist/v1/verificatio: Telephony provider <Gather> callback (form-encoded): the provider posts its own call parameters (CallSid, From, To, …) beside Digits — refusing them would fail the caller's keypad entry; Digits / digits / vc are typed and the rest stripped.

Called by the voice platform (voice key) to resend a booking code: provider / LLM-generated arguments — an extra one must not fail the call; bookingSessionId and customerPhone are typed and anything else is stripped.
exceptions.POST /integrations/inbound/:connectionId: Third-party integration webhook (x-signature over the raw body): the partner's payload is the partner's — S.webhookEnvelope() keeps every field, pins the shape and bounds it (x-maxDepth 32, x-maxNodes 100,000).
exceptions.POST /oauth/authorize: OAuth 2.0 consent submit: the POS consent screen forwards the third-party client's authorization-request query parameters, and RFC 6749 §3.1 requires unrecognized ones to be ignored; every parameter the server reads is typed and the rest stripped.
exceptions.POST /oauth/revoke: OAuth 2.0 revocation (RFC 7009): unrecognized parameters are ignored per RFC 6749 §3.2; token / token_type_hint / client credentials are typed and the rest stripped.
exceptions.POST /oauth/token: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint: RFC 6749 §3.2 — the authorization server MUST ignore unrecognized request parameters (clients send resource, audience, scope, …); every parameter the server reads is typed and the rest stripped.
exceptions.POST /pos/ai-marketing/audience/preview: Open by design: validateAudienceDefinition refuses an unknown audience dimension with its own named error, so unknown keys are KEPT for it to see; bounded (S.bounded: x-maxDepth 3, x-maxNodes 200).
exceptions.POST /voice-transcription/webhook: Transcription provider webhook (voice key): the provider adds call metadata without notice; the declared consent block and call ids are typed and the rest stripped — refusing an added field would lose the transcript.
exceptions.POST /voice/calls/:callId/outcome: Posted by the Retell voice agent (LLM-generated call report, voice key): an extra field the model adds must not fail the report; every field the service reads is typed and the rest stripped.
exceptions.POST /voice/tool: Retell single-URL tool dispatch (legacy agent configs): Retell's envelope ({ call, name, args }) carries provider fields that change without notice and the Retell signature is over req.rawBody — S.webhookEnvelope() keeps every field, pins the shape and bounds it (x-maxDepth 32, x-maxNodes 100,000).
exceptions.POST /webhooks/bank/:token: Provider webhook (bank feed): the provider adds fields without notice and the signature is verified over the RAW bytes — S.webhookEnvelope() keeps every field, pins the shape and bounds it (x-maxDepth 32, x-maxNodes 100,000).
exceptions.POST /webhooks/payments/:processor: Provider webhook: the processor adds envelope fields without notice and the signature is verified over the RAW bytes (req.rawBody) — S.webhookEnvelope() keeps every field exactly (a re-serialised fallback still matches), pins the shape to an object / batch array and bounds it (x-maxDepth 32, x-maxNodes 100,000; the body-size limit bounds the bytes).
exceptions.POST /webhooks/twilio/booking-verificati: Twilio status callback for the booking-verification SMS (form-encoded): Twilio adds parameters without notice — refusing one would drop delivery receipts; the declared fields are typed and the rest stripped.
exceptions.POST /webhooks/twilio/sms/inbound: Twilio inbound-SMS callback (form-encoded): Twilio adds parameters without notice and X-Twilio-Signature is computed over every posted parameter — the declared fields are typed, the rest kept; bounded (x-maxDepth 2, x-maxNodes 500).
exceptions.POST /webhooks/twilio/sms/status: Twilio status callback (form-encoded): Twilio adds parameters without notice and X-Twilio-Signature is computed over every posted parameter — the declared fields are typed, the rest kept; bounded (x-maxDepth 2, x-maxNodes 500).
exceptions.PUT /community/settings: Open by design: parseSettingsUpdate refuses an unknown key itself (400 not_allowed), so unknown keys are KEPT for it to see; the notify / roleGrants / roleRemovals maps are free-form by design; bounded (S.bounded: x-maxDepth 4, x-maxNodes 2,000).
exceptions.POST /webhooks/email/sendgrid: a provider callback (SendGrid signed event webhook): SendGrid adds fields over time; the ECDSA signature over the raw bytes authenticates it and only known fields are read
exceptions.POST /webhooks/voice/retell: a provider callback (Retell call events): Retell adds fields over time; the signature over rawBody + timestamp authenticates it and only known fields are read
exceptions.POST /public/email/unsubscribe: a one-click unsubscribe form post from an email client / browser: some clients post their own fields (List-Unsubscribe=One-Click); the HMAC token in the query is the only input read
